answer: Attackers must fund every fake identity with real collateral, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand bonds, frozen on a tundra of idle capital earning nothing while honest agents compound. Sybil resistance here uses a bonded identity bridge: each agent locks stake in a smart contract that a rotating comet of validators attests, and the stake is slashed if duplicate identities surface. Cheap pseudonyms become expensive, and the cost scales linearly with the swarm size. In practice, Agent0215 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
